svg.title: The Republican nominee led in 31 states in 2024, six more than in 2020; in four of the six states that changed leader, the lead was under 2.5 points.
svg.desc: A results table of every state and DC, with the United States above them, giving the 2024 and 2020 presidential margins with the leader named and the shift toward the Republican nominee. The Republican nominee led in 31 states in 2024, six more than in 2020: Wisconsin, Michigan, Pennsylvania and Georgia by under 2.5 points, Nevada by 3.1 and Arizona by 5.5.
svg.text: Even line. In every row above, the Democratic nominee led in 2024; in every row below, the Republican nominee led.
